verses.original: δὲ γίνωσκε Τοῦτο ὅτι ἐν ἐσχάταις ἡμέραις χαλεποί καιροὶ ἐνστήσονται
verses.transliteration: de ginōske Touto hoti en eschatais hēmerais chalepoi kairoi enstēsontai
verses.literal: But understand this - In [the] last days terrible times will come

verses.original: γὰρ οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἔσονται φίλαυτοι φιλάργυροι ἀλαζόνες ὑπερήφανοι βλάσφημοι ἀπειθεῖς γονεῦσιν ἀχάριστοι ἀνόσιοι
verses.transliteration: gar hoi anthrōpoi esontai philautoi philargyroi alazones hyperēphanoi blasphēmoi apeitheis goneusin acharistoi anosioi
verses.literal: For - men will be lovers of themselves lovers of money boastful arrogant abusive disobedient to [their] parents ungrateful unholy

verses.original: ἄστοργοι ἄσπονδοι διάβολοι ἀκρατεῖς ἀνήμεροι ἀφιλάγαθοι
verses.transliteration: astorgoi aspondoi diaboloi akrateis anēmeroi aphilagathoi
verses.literal: unloving unforgiving slanderous without self-control brutal without love of good

verses.original: προδόται προπετεῖς τετυφωμένοι φιλήδονοι μᾶλλον ἢ φιλόθεοι
verses.transliteration: prodotai propeteis tetyphōmenoi philēdonoi mallon ē philotheoi
verses.literal: traitorous reckless conceited lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God

verses.original: ἔχοντες μόρφωσιν εὐσεβείας δὲ ἠρνημένοι αὐτῆς τὴν δύναμιν καὶ ἀποτρέπου τούτους
verses.transliteration: echontes morphōsin eusebeias de ērnēmenoi autēs tēn dynamin kai apotrepou toutous
verses.literal: having a form of godliness but denying its - power - Turn away from [such] as these

verses.original: γάρ εἰσιν οἱ Ἐκ τούτων ἐνδύνοντες εἰς τὰς οἰκίας καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες γυναικάρια σεσωρευμένα ἁμαρτίαις ἀγόμενα ποικίλαις ἐπιθυμίαις
verses.transliteration: gar eisin hoi Ek toutōn endynontes eis tas oikias kai aichmalōtizontes gynaikaria sesōreumena hamartiais agomena poikilais epithymiais
verses.literal: - They are - vvv the kind who worm their way into - households and captivate vulnerable women [who are] weighed down with sins [and] led astray by various passions

verses.original: πάντοτε μανθάνοντα καὶ μηδέποτε δυνάμενα ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: pantote manthanonta kai mēdepote dynamena elthein eis epignōsin alētheias
verses.literal: [who are] always learning [but] never able to come to a knowledge of [the] truth

verses.original: ὃν τρόπον δὲ Ἰάννης καὶ Ἰαμβρῆς ἀντέστησαν Μωϋσεῖ οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι ἄνθρωποι ἀνθίστανται τῇ ἀληθείᾳ κατεφθαρμένοι τὸν νοῦν ἀδόκιμοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν
verses.transliteration: hon tropon de Iannēs kai Iambrēs antestēsan Mōusei houtōs kai houtoi anthrōpoi anthistantai tē alētheia katephtharmenoi ton noun adokimoi peri tēn pistin
verses.literal: Just as . . . . . . Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses so also these men oppose the truth They are depraved - in mind [and] disqualified from the faith

verses.original: ἀλλ’ οὐ προκόψουσιν πλεῖον ἐπὶ γὰρ καὶ ὡς ἡ ἐκείνων ἐγένετο αὐτῶν ἡ ἄνοια ἔσται ἔκδηλος πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: all’ ou prokopsousin pleion epi gar kai hōs hē ekeinōn egeneto autōn hē anoia estai ekdēlos pasin
verses.literal: But vvv they will not advance much further For just like - [Jannes and Jambres] - their - folly will be plain to everyone

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ παρηκολούθησάς μου τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ τῇ ἀγωγῇ τῇ προθέσει τῇ πίστει τῇ μακροθυμίᾳ τῇ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ὑπομονῇ
verses.transliteration: Sy de parēkolouthēsas mou tē didaskalia tē agōgē tē prothesei tē pistei tē makrothymia tē agapē tē hypomonē
verses.literal: You however have observed my - teaching [my] conduct [my] purpose [my] faith [my] patience [my] love [my] perseverance

verses.original: τοῖς διωγμοῖς τοῖς παθήμασιν οἷά ἐγένετο μοι ἐν Ἀντιοχείᾳ ἐν Ἰκονίῳ ἐν Λύστροις οἵους διωγμοὺς ὑπήνεγκα καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἐρρύσατο με ἐκ πάντων
verses.transliteration: tois diōgmois tois pathēmasin hoia egeneto moi en Antiocheia en Ikoniō en Lystrois hoious diōgmous hypēnenka kai ho Kyrios errysato me ek pantōn
verses.literal: [my] persecutions [and the] sufferings that came upon me in Antioch - Iconium [and] Lystra What persecutions I endured Yet the Lord rescued me from all [of them]

verses.original: καὶ δὲ πάντες οἱ θέλοντες ζῆν εὐσεβῶς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ διωχθήσονται
verses.transliteration: kai de pantes hoi thelontes zēn eusebōs en Christō Iēsou diōchthēsontai
verses.literal: - Indeed all who desire to live godly [lives] in Christ Jesus will be persecuted

verses.original: δὲ πονηροὶ ἄνθρωποι καὶ γόητες προκόψουσιν ἐπὶ τὸ χεῖρον πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι
verses.transliteration: de ponēroi anthrōpoi kai goētes prokopsousin epi to cheiron planōntes kai planōmenoi
verses.literal: while evil men and imposters go [from bad] to - worse deceiving and being deceived

verses.original: δὲ Σὺ μένε ἐν οἷς ἔμαθες καὶ ἐπιστώθης εἰδὼς παρὰ τίνων ἔμαθες
verses.transliteration: de Sy mene en hois emathes kai epistōthēs eidōs para tinōn emathes
verses.literal: But [as for] you continue in the things you have learned and firmly believed since you know from whom you have learned [them]

verses.original: καὶ ὅτι ἀπὸ βρέφους οἶδας τὰ ἱερὰ γράμματα τὰ δυνάμενά σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai hoti apo brephous oidas ta hiera grammata ta dynamena se sophisai eis sōtērian dia pisteōs tēs en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: - - From infancy you have known the Holy Scriptures which are able vvv to make you wise for salvation through faith - in Christ Jesus

verses.original: πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν πρὸς ἐλεγμόν πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν πρὸς παιδείαν ἐν τὴν δικαιοσύνῃ
verses.transliteration: pasa graphē theopneustos kai ōphelimos pros didaskalian pros elegmon pros epanorthōsin pros paideian en tēn dikaiosynē
verses.literal: All Scripture [is] God-breathed and is useful for instruction for conviction for correction [and] for training in - righteousness

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ ἄνθρωπος τοῦ Θεοῦ ᾖ ἄρτιος ἐξηρτισμένος πρὸς πᾶν ἀγαθὸν ἔργον
verses.transliteration: hina ho anthrōpos tou Theou ē artios exērtismenos pros pan agathon ergon
verses.literal: so that the man - of God may be complete fully equipped for every good work
